# Never Split the Difference

By Voss.

Lent my copy to Frank, ask for it back in Wednesday meeting. Not as good as the previous book by the same author. Iris recommended it after our conversation about focus.

Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory. The main argument is that small habits compound over years. Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.

Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.
